name: base-memecoin-guard-mcp
display_name: Base Memecoin Guard: honeypot, rug pull, exit liquidity, smart money
description: Base memecoin safety for trading agents: honeypot, rug pull, exit liquidity, smart money
long_description: Safety and alpha for agents trading Base memecoins, paid per call (x402, USDC on Base) from the user's own wallet within a per-call cap and session budget. Before buying: guard_check (honeypot, rug pull, tax, exit liquidity at your size, insiders, snipers, deployer) or the free guard_preview. Attention: pulse_token / pulse_trending (shill score, velocity). Smart money and copy trade: signals_*. After buying: watch_24h / watch_72h / watch_7d alert on liquidity pulls, dev dumps and exit traps; read alerts free with watch_events. Each tool states its price; tools marked FREE need no wallet. Results are automated facts and flags, not investment advice.

x402_private_key.title: Wallet private key
x402_private_key.description: Private key of your own Base mainnet wallet holding a little USDC. Optional: without it only the free tools work.

max_per_call_usd.title: Max USD per call
max_per_call_usd.description: Most a single tool call may pay.

session_budget_usd.title: Session budget USD
session_budget_usd.description: Most the server may spend until it restarts.

tools.name: guard_check
tools.description: Full pre-trade safety report for a Base memecoin or new token launch: honeypot and rug pull checks, buy/sell/transfer tax, exit liquidity at YOUR position size (price impact, slippage), insider, sniper and bundle forensics, funder clusters, deployer track record, liquidity and LP lock. Call before buying. Price: $0.05 USDC per call via x402 on Base, paid from your own wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY) within your per-call cap and session budget; charged only for a successful answer.

tools.name: guard_exit_liquidity
tools.description: Can you actually sell? Simulates exiting a Base token position of a given USD size (or raw token amount): price impact, slippage and realisable USD across the token's pools. Exit-liquidity and honeypot sanity check before sizing a trade. Price: $0.02 USDC per call via x402 on Base, paid from your own wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY) within your per-call cap and session budget; charged only for a successful answer.

tools.name: guard_batch

Use guard_check for the full paid report with reasons. FREE: no wallet or payment needed.
